Kunitama Shrine] - Shizuoka Prefecture Shrine Office</ref>. {{nihongo|'''Kunitama Shrine'''|国玉神社 (伊豆市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

== Overview ==
It is located along the Odoi ?kawa River, north of {{ill|Hachiman Shrine (Otoi)|Q134927674|qid=Q134927674|lt=Hachiman Shrine}}, which is itself along Prefectural Route 17 (Numazu-T?i Line), inland to the east of the Odoi district at the northern end of the T?i area (former {{ill|Toi, Shizuoka|Q3530413|qid=Q3530413}}) in Izu City.

Its founding is unknown, but it is identified as the {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} "Kunitama-no-Mikoto Shrine" (????????????), and is an ancient shrine also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no kuni jinjaich?|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "J?shi-i no J? Kunitama-hime no My?jin"<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/kunitama_title.htm Kunitama Shrine] - Genmatsushi</ref>.
